title: LEGEND
sub: Vietnamese legend says a golden turtle gave a king a claw, to make the trigger of a magic crossbow.
say: Vietnamese legend says a golden turtle gave a king a claw, to make the trigger of a magic crossbow.

title: AN DƯƠNG
sub: The king was An Dương, at his spiral citadel of Cổ Loa.
say: The king was Ahn Zuong, at his spiral citadel of Koh Lwah.

title: TRỌNG THỦY & MỴ CHÂU
sub: So Zhao Tuo made peace, the story goes, and his son Trọng Thủy married the king's daughter, Mỵ Châu.
say: So Jow Twaw made peace, the story goes, and his son Chong Twee married the king's daughter, Mee Chow.

title: THE SWAP
sub: Trọng Thủy secretly swapped the claw, then went home. Zhao Tuo attacked, and the crossbow failed.
say: Chong Twee secretly swapped the claw, then went home. Jow Twaw attacked, and the crossbow failed.

title: CỔ LOA IS REAL
sub: Archaeology adds something else. Cổ Loa is real: huge earthen walls, the oldest layers from around 300 BC.
say: Archaeology adds something else. Koh Lwah is real: huge earthen walls, the oldest layers from around 300 BC.

title: NOT PROOF
sub: Digs found bronze arrowheads, and stone moulds to cast them. That shows a strong local power. It does not prove the legend.
say: Digs found bronze arrowheads, and stone moulds to cast them. That shows a strong local power. It does not prove the legend.

title: MỴ CHÂU?
sub: And what happened to Mỵ Châu?
say: And what happened to Mee Chow?
